title: AUTH-066 short access Home mount acquires recovery

assertionSteps.title: 1. Given User A is authenticated as user-a in an isolated browser context

steps.title: Install clock "Tue Jan 01 2030 08:00:00 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"

assertionSteps.title: 2. And restored fixture workspace WS-A is configured; access A expires in 10 seconds; no refresh credential exists
3. When the Home page finishes its initial mount
4. Then the browser records exactly 1 new POST requests to "/api/auth/v2/sso/refreshtoken"
5. When the fixture accepts that acquisition with refresh R valid beyond access expiry
6. And the controlled browser clock advances exactly 10 seconds
7. Then the dialog named "Your session has been expired" on the Home page is visible

9. Then the browser records exactly 1 new POST requests to "/api/auth/v2/sso/relogin"
10. And the recovery POST header Single-UI-Refresh equals R
11. When the fixture accepts manual recovery with a new access credential
12. Then the tab labelled "WS-A" inside the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page is visible
